SNEHA GAWDE

snehagawde0911@gmail.com • +918082526998 • Mumbai, Maharashtra, India • linkedin.com/in/sneha-

gawde-85b66b91	

SUMMARY

Experienced Java Software Engineer with a strong foundation in Java, Spring Framework, microservices and Hibernate. Proven track record in concurrent programming and relational databases. Skilled in test-driven development and delivering high-quality software solutions.

EXPERIENCE

Iris Software Inc., Senior Engineer- technology

Mar 2022 - Present

MUFG Bank :

Developed and integrated LDAP-based backend authentication for secure user validation, enhancing system security and user experience.

Designed and implemented custom Java processors to process queued inputs with sequential operations and database persistence, achieving 100% improvement in processing efficiency.

Achieved full line and 80% branch coverage with thorough JUnit tests, reinforcing code reliability and stability, reducing system errors by 50%.

Citi bank:

Refactored appendix persistence logic into a separate class, enabling structured data segregation across three tables, improving data management efficiency.

Conducted comprehensive code reviews and implemented unit and integration tests using JUnit, ensuring system reliability and reducing defects.

Optimized codebase and introduced microservices, reducing processing time and enhancing scalability.

MSI:

Designed and developed 33 reports, metric cards, and dashboards based on functional specs, improving data presentation efficiency through impactful data visualization using charts and stacked bars.

Utilized PLSQL and Apache Groovy to create multiple reports and dashboards, enhancing data analysis capabilities and user experience, resulting in increase in user satisfaction.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate data representation and timely delivery of reports, contributing to increase in project completion rate.

Synechron, Lead Technology

Dec 2021 - Mar 2022

Supported 10+ Java 7/8 applications for a major power utility, enhancing functionality and optimizing performance using Spring and Spring Boot.

Delivered client-driven improvements and resolved issues to ensure application stability and efficiency. Developed and maintained REST web services, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

Accenture Services, Application Development Senior Analyst

Aug 2014 - Dec 2021

Duke Energy:

Supported 10+ Java 7/8 applications for a major power utility, enhancing functionality and optimizing performance using Spring and Spring Boot, resulting in improvement in system efficiency.

Delivered client-driven improvements and resolved issues, ensuring application stability and efficiency, reducing system errors.

Developed and maintained REST web services, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance, achieving 70% uptime.

RMP (German Bank)

Delivered end-to-end credit, market, and operational risk calculations for a leading bank using Spring Batch and Spark Batch, achieving 100% line and branch coverage with robust JUnit tests.

Led technical design, development, and integration testing using Java 8 and Spark, Worked with big data reducing system errors.

Spearheaded module ownership and collaborated with QA team for 3 months, driving seamless integration testing and earning the Onshore Excellence Award (Nov 2016).

BDO (German BANK)



Implemented secure web services and online portals, enhancing connectivity and user experience, contributing to the digital transformation of a leading bank.

Managed legitimation services, overseeing authentication/authorization flows, LDAP attribute management, and enforcement of password policies, improving security protocols.

Configured JRebel and XRebel for hot code deployment, accelerating development cycles and reducing deployment time.

EDUCATION

Thakur College of engineering

Bachelor of engineering in Computers • Computer Science • 2011 - 2014

LICENSES & CERTIFICATIONS

oracle java associate certificate

Oracle • 1z0-808 •

Teilnahmezertifikat von Deutschen Sprachtraining

Deutschen Sprachtraining •

Developer certificate for Apache Spark

O'Reilly •

Azure Fundamentals

SKILLS

Microservices • Spring Boot • Oracle Database • Microsoft SQL Server • Jenkins • Docker Products • Kubernetes

Apache Kafka • Apache Camel • Java

HONORS & AWARDS

Onshore excellence award Star of the Month

Star Performer of the Month Outstanding Bahubali award
